music_strings_bend_all_in_tune: Every bend in tune: within {cents} cents of {note}.
music_strings_bend_assist: The string, fret and target stay on screen. The microphone scores where each bend settles.
music_strings_bend_avg: {n} of {total} in tune. On average you landed {where}.
music_strings_bend_avg_ease: {n} of {total} in tune. On average you landed {where}: ease off a little.
music_strings_bend_avg_push: {n} of {total} in tune. On average you landed {where}: push a little further.
music_strings_bend_blurb: Bend to pitch and hold it, or hold a note with vibrato. Needs the microphone.
music_strings_bend_mic_failed: Bends need the microphone, and it didn't start. Check the browser allows it.
music_strings_bend_mic_hint: The microphone scores each bend: play close to it.
music_strings_bend_no_vibrato: No vibrato heard: the pitch stayed still, or the note was too short.
music_strings_bend_none_held: No bend was held. Pick the note, push the string up, and keep it at the top for a moment.
music_strings_bend_norms: In tune is within {inTune} cents, close within {close}: starting values, since no norms for bends are published.
music_strings_bend_not_held_line: Not held: bend up and keep it there for a moment.
music_strings_bend_prompt_bend: {n} of {total}: pick {from}, bend it to {to} and hold.
music_strings_bend_prompt_vibrato: {n} of {total}: hold {note} with vibrato for {seconds} seconds.
music_strings_bend_tap_neck: Tap the neck to choose the string and fret.
music_strings_bend_trace: Pitch over the last four seconds, cents above {from}
music_strings_bend_trace_to: Pitch over the last four seconds, cents above {from}. The dashed line is {to}
music_strings_bend_vibrato_assist: A try counts when vibrato is heard. Its rate and width are described, not scored: no published norm says what they should be.
music_strings_bend_vibrato_at: Vibrato at {rate} a second, {width} cents wide.
music_strings_bend_vibrato_none: No vibrato heard. Rock the string a little across the fret, steadily, while the note sounds.
music_strings_bend_vibrato_summary: Vibrato at about {rate} a second, {width} cents wide. Players use roughly 4 to 7 a second. Keep it even.
music_strings_changes_bar_sr: {date}: {rate} per minute, {clean} of {completed} with every note
music_strings_changes_blurb: Move round two to eight chords and back. Each set keeps its changes per minute.
music_strings_changes_clean_clock: every change with every note, on the click
music_strings_changes_first_run: First run on {cycle}: {rate}. Your chart starts with the next one.
music_strings_changes_hardest_empty: play a few pairs first, and the slowest show here.
music_strings_changes_hardest_help: Your slowest pairs, by changes a minute over each one's last three runs.
music_strings_changes_how_counts_text: A change counts when the next chord's target notes all sound and nothing else does. Which string sounded each note isn't measured.
music_strings_changes_mic_hint: Optional: strum into the microphone, or tap the chord's strings here.
music_strings_changes_none_landed: No change landed yet: play {first}, pause, then {second}.
music_strings_changes_nothing_heard: Nothing was heard during the run. Tap the strings, strum into the microphone, or connect MIDI, then try again.
music_strings_changes_on_click: {onTime} of {completed} landed on the click: change on the beat to pass.
music_strings_changes_pause_hint: Pause briefly between chords. Stop when you're done: the changes you played are scored.

match.completedPlural=one: {completed} change, {clean} with every target note, at {rate} per minute.
match.completedPlural=other: {completed} changes, {clean} with every target note, at {rate} per minute.

match.completedPlural=other: {completed} changes, {clean} with every target note, at {rate} per minute (aim for 60).

music_strings_changes_run_headline: {rate} changes per minute, {clean} of {completed} with every note
music_strings_chordpicker_shell_hint: Root, 3rd and 7th on three strings, the root on string 6 or 5.
music_strings_cycle_help: Tap a chord to change it. The run goes round them in order and back to the first.
music_strings_cycle_one_shape: One shape for this chord on this tuning.
music_strings_exam_help: The exam's click becomes the goal the tempo climbs to. Rockschool Electric 2018 and Trinity classical minimums. Neither says how many notes fall on a click.
music_strings_find_blurb_note: A note is named. Find it on the neck inside a five-fret window, on any string.
music_strings_find_blurb_recall: From the square, find the note a set interval up, inside a five-fret window.
music_strings_find_intro_note: A note name appears here. Tap it on the neck, or play it.
music_strings_find_intro_recall: A square marks the starting note. Find the interval above it. You can sound the square first.
music_strings_find_mic_hint: Optional: answer on your instrument into the microphone, or tap the neck here.
music_strings_find_on_lit: On a lit string and fret
music_strings_find_some: {n} of {total} found. Look again at the misses below before the next round.
music_strings_find_stopped: Stopped. Your answers so far are saved.
music_strings_find_ukulele_no_skill: No ukulele interval skill yet: this run is kept as practice history, not counted toward your skill scores.
music_strings_find_up_any: up from the square, on any string
music_strings_fingering_note: Finger numbers on the keys are suggestions. They're never scored: MIDI can't see fingers.
music_strings_grade_no_left_root: no root in the left hand
music_strings_ladder_at: Tempo ladder: this run is at {bpm} BPM. Two clean Check runs here unlock the next tempo.
music_strings_ladder_below: Practice at {bpm} BPM. Clean runs raise the tempo. The ladder starts at {start} BPM.
music_strings_ladder_help: Two clean Check runs at a tempo unlock the next one. The ringed tempo is the one on the top bar.
music_strings_ladder_starts: Tempo ladder: starts at {bpm} BPM, and clean Check runs climb it.
music_strings_line_blurb_harm: Natural harmonics over frets 12, 7 and 5: touch the string, pick, and lift.
music_strings_line_blurb_legato: Pick only the ↓ notes. Hammer, pull off or slide to the rest, as the tab writes them.
music_strings_line_blurb_pick: A picking pattern over two or more chords: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring.
music_strings_line_blurb_positions: Pentatonic and CAGED boxes, the B.B. box or triads, low string to high, a note a click.
music_strings_line_blurb_spider: One finger per fret, one note per click, until each finger lands on its own.
music_strings_line_blurb_uke: A minor pentatonic position, string 4 to string 1, in five positions up the neck.
music_strings_line_check_note: Check: no targets. The frets you play still light.
music_strings_line_clean: Clean at {bpm} BPM. Every finger landed.
music_strings_line_clean_even: Clean and even at {bpm} BPM. Every finger landed.
music_strings_line_demo: Demo: the line at tempo, lit as it sounds.
music_strings_line_detuned_guitar: {clean} of {total} notes right. {n} sounded out of tune (about {cents} cents): tune your guitar in Tuner, then try again.
music_strings_line_detuned_ukulele: {clean} of {total} notes right. {n} sounded out of tune (about {cents} cents): tune your ukulele in Tuner, then try again.
music_strings_line_harm_help: Touch lightly right over the fret wire, pick near the bridge, then lift the finger. The microphone hears the harmonic. A tap on the neck at 12, 7 or 5 stands for it.
music_strings_line_legato_mic: Hammer-ons and pull-offs (the microphone hears the pick)
music_strings_line_legato_row: Hammered and pulled with no new pick attack
music_strings_line_legato_tap: Tap the neck on the stage to choose the string and start fret.
music_strings_line_mic_guitar: Optional: play on your guitar into the microphone, or tap the frets here.
music_strings_line_mic_ukulele: Optional: play on your ukulele into the microphone, or tap the frets here.
music_strings_line_nothing_heard: Nothing was heard during the run. Tap the frets, play into the microphone, or connect MIDI, then try again.
music_strings_line_on_written: On the written string and fret
music_strings_line_pick_spider: Tap the neck to move the pattern's first fret.
music_strings_line_pick_start: Tap the neck to start somewhere else: the string and the start fret.
music_strings_line_ready_fingers: Numbers and colours are fingers: 1 index to 4 pinky.
music_strings_line_ready_harm: H marks where to touch the string, right over the fret, without pressing it.
music_strings_line_ready_legato: ↓ is picked, h hammered on, p pulled off, / and \ slid up and down. Colours are your fingers.
music_strings_line_ready_pick: Letters are the picking hand, colours the fretting hand. {chord} is shown. The others follow in the run.
music_strings_line_ready_spider: Numbers are the order you play. Colours are your fingers.
music_strings_line_slips_many: {clean} of {total} notes right first time: {slips} steps had a wrong note before the right one.
music_strings_line_slips_one: {clean} of {total} notes right first time: one step had a wrong note before the right one.
music_strings_line_slow_down: Slow down until each finger lands before the next.
music_strings_line_some_right: {clean} of {total} notes right. Slow down until each finger lands before the next.
music_strings_line_spoken_back: target, stretch back toward the nut
music_strings_line_uneven: Every note right, but the spacing wandered by {ms} ms. Keep it even.
music_strings_mark_note_finger: A note, with its finger (1 index to 4 little)
music_strings_mic_didnt_start: The microphone didn't start. Check the browser allows it.
music_strings_mic_far_too_loud: Far too loud: move well back
music_strings_mic_hint: Sit close to the sound hole, about a hand's width away.
music_strings_mic_too_loud: Too loud: move back a little
music_strings_neck_marks: What the marks on the neck mean
music_strings_nothing_scored: Nothing was scored, so no score, XP or skill score changed. Strum again when you're ready.

{notes} is out of the {inst}'s range here.

music_strings_pos_bb: The B.B. box sits five frets above the string-6 root: the index on the root, string 2.
music_strings_pos_retuned: On {tuning}, each note keeps its pitch, so a retuned string's notes sit higher or lower than the shape you know.
music_strings_pos_shapes: Shapes are named by the root on string 6.
music_strings_pos_stretch: An arrow is a stretch: ←1 reaches back with the index, 4→ up with the pinky (more than a fret means moving the hand).
music_strings_pos_triads: Triads are named by the root on string 6. Each inversion sits higher up the neck.
music_strings_pos_uke: Positions are named by the root on string 1.
music_strings_practice_history_only: Kept as practice history, not counted toward your skill scores yet.
music_strings_round_circle_hint: After a clean Check run the tonic moves up a fifth: {keys} and on through all 12.
music_strings_row_which_string_note: Which string each note came from
music_strings_scales_blurb: Scales, arpeggios and inversions, evenly at the click, up to a UK exam grade's speed.
music_strings_scales_check_frets: Check: play the {what}, {n} steps. No targets. The frets you play still light, and a slip is named.
music_strings_scales_check_keys: Check: play the {what}, {n} steps. No targets. The keys you play still light, and a slip is named.
music_strings_scales_clean_bpm_grade: Clean and even at {bpm} BPM. {grade} speed is {speed} with {per}.
music_strings_scales_clean_means_even: a score of 90% or more, with evenness at {pct} or more
music_strings_scales_demo: Demo: the whole line at tempo, lit as it sounds.

match.inst=*: {clean} of {total} notes right. {notes} sounded about {cents} cents out: tune your {inst} in Tuner, then try again.

music_strings_scales_fingering: Numbers are fingers, 1 thumb to 5 little finger, as the scale books print them.
music_strings_scales_no_fingering: No standard fingering for this scale here: keep the thumb off the black keys and cross it under after 3 or 4.
music_strings_scales_preset_plain: One note a click, no grade target
music_strings_scales_preset_together: Hands together, one octave, up, 80 BPM
music_strings_scales_slipped: Slipped on {list}: a wrong note came first.
music_strings_scales_slipped_each: Slipped on {list}: a wrong note came first on each.
music_strings_scales_slow_down: Slow down until each note lands before the next.
music_strings_scales_some_right: {clean} of {total} notes right. Slow down until each note lands before the next.
music_strings_scales_start_hint_1: An arpeggio in first inversion, from the 3rd to the 3rd.
music_strings_scales_start_hint_2: An arpeggio in second inversion, from the 5th to the 5th.
music_strings_scales_start_hint_3: An arpeggio in third inversion, from the 7th to the 7th.
music_strings_scales_tempo_help: Tempo comes from the top bar (40 to 180 BPM). Two clean runs at 85% raise it. At 120 BPM the next run moves from one note a click to two, then four. ABRSM's speeds are "a general guide".
music_strings_shape_all_matched_check: All {total} target notes of {symbol} matched in Check.
music_strings_shape_blurb_build: Fret the shape, then sound each string from string {from} to string {to}.
music_strings_shape_blurb_pick: Hold the shape and pick one string per click, string {from} to string {to}.
music_strings_shape_demo_strum: Demo: {symbol}, string by string, then strummed.
music_strings_shape_mic_hint_guitar: Optional: pluck your guitar into the microphone, one string at a time, or tap the strings here.
music_strings_shape_mic_hint_ukulele: Optional: pluck your ukulele into the microphone, one string at a time, or tap the strings here.
music_strings_shape_near_flat: {heard} is {cents} cents flat of a chord note: check your tuning.
music_strings_shape_near_sharp: {heard} is {cents} cents sharp of a chord note: check your tuning.
music_strings_shape_nothing_heard: Nothing was heard during the run. Tap the strings, play into the microphone, or connect MIDI, then try again.
music_strings_shape_play_build: Play {symbol}: fret the shape, then sound string {string} first.
music_strings_shape_scored_hint: Scored: which notes you sounded. Not scored: which string they came from, or how clean they rang.
music_strings_shape_stop_when_done: Stop when you're done: what you played is scored.
music_strings_shape_wrong_check: Wrong note: {heard} isn't one of the notes still to play.
music_strings_shape_wrong_not_in: Wrong note: {heard} isn't in the chord.
music_strings_spider_bursts_hint: Each four-note cell fast, then a rest as long. Push the tempo while it stays even.
music_strings_spider_strings_help: Tap to add or remove. They play from the lowest string up.
music_strings_spider_tap_help: Tap the fingers below in the order you want to play them.
music_strings_stopped_tries_saved: Stopped. The tries you finished are saved.
music_strings_strum_all_strums: All {total} chords followed, every strum on time.
music_strings_strum_any_help: Any strum: what counts is each chord ringing on its bar. Pick a pattern in Setup to practise one.
music_strings_strum_blurb: Strum the pattern through the chart while the microphone follows each chord.
music_strings_strum_chart_help: Eight bars in {key} you haven't seen: read it once, then strum it. Some bars change chord on beat 3.
music_strings_strum_clean_strums: every strum on time on its chord, every chord followed
music_strings_strum_demo_pattern: Demo: one chorus, {pattern}. The microphone isn't listening.
music_strings_strum_demo_plain: Demo: one chorus, strummed on beats one and three. The microphone isn't listening.
music_strings_strum_highway_on: Highway: each strum slides down to the line as it's due.
music_strings_strum_metric_strums: strums on time on the chord
music_strings_strum_mic_failed: The microphone didn't start. Check the browser allows it, then press Start again.
music_strings_strum_none_heard: No strums were heard. Check the level meter moves when you play, then try again.
music_strings_strum_run_strums: {n} of {total} strums on time on the chord
music_strings_strum_slots_label: {pattern}, one bar: down and up strokes on the count
music_strings_strum_strums_line: {n} of {total} strums on time on the chord.
music_strings_strum_tones_of_live: Tones of {chord}, against what the microphone hears
music_strings_strum_why_guitar: The microphone hears which notes ring after each strum, not which strings rang them. Chord following hasn't been tested on a real guitar yet. So a run is kept as practice history, with your timing, but doesn't change a skill score.
music_strings_strum_why_title: Why this run doesn't count toward skills
music_strings_strum_why_ukulele: The microphone hears which notes ring after each strum, not which strings rang them. Chord following hasn't been tested on a real ukulele yet. So a run is kept as practice history, with your timing, but doesn't change a skill score.
music_strings_strum_work_on: {chord} is the one to work on first.
music_strings_strumid_blurb: Strum the chord once into the microphone. Woodshed names what it heard and scores each tone.
music_strings_strumid_mic_limits: The microphone hears which notes ring, not which string rang them or how clean each one was. Inversions read as the same chord.
music_strings_strumid_none_heard: No strum was heard in eight seconds. Strum a little harder, close to the microphone.
music_strings_strumid_one_tone: Not enough tones to name a chord: heard only one tone ({notes}). {symbol} needs {need}, so nothing was saved.
music_strings_strumid_play: Play {symbol} as one strum and let it ring.
music_strings_strumid_rang_as: That rang as {symbol}: every target tone, nothing extra.
music_strings_strumid_too_quiet: The strum was too quiet to read any tones. Nothing saved. Move closer and strum again.
music_strings_strumid_two_tones: Not enough tones to name a chord: heard two tones ({notes}). {symbol} needs {need}, so nothing was saved.
music_strings_th_about_alberti: Left hand plays an Alberti figure in eighths. The right hand holds one note per beat.
music_strings_th_about_contrary_five: Both thumbs on {tonic}, an octave apart. Walk outward, then back, same finger in both hands on every beat.
music_strings_th_about_contrary_scale: Both hands run the scale in eighths, moving in opposite directions.
music_strings_th_about_lh_pulse: Left hand holds the root on every beat while the right hand runs eighths up and down the scale.
music_strings_th_about_lh_shell: Left hand walks root, fifth, seventh, fifth. The right hand plays an eighth-note fragment over it.
music_strings_th_about_rh_pulse: Roles swapped: the right hand keeps the pulse, the left hand runs the eighth-note line.
music_strings_th_blurb: Each hand plays its own part on the click. Mirror hands asks them to strike together.
music_strings_th_check_note: Check: the lane keeps the rhythm, the notes are hidden.
music_strings_th_clean_check: Both parts clean at {bpm} BPM, in Check.
music_strings_th_clean_means: every note on its beat, no wrong keys
music_strings_th_clean_together: Clean, and the hands struck together on {n} of {total} beats.
music_strings_th_clean_together_means: every note on its beat, hands together, no wrong keys
music_strings_th_demo: Demo: both hands at tempo. Notes in one column of the lane strike together.
music_strings_th_dynamics_left: Dynamics: play the left hand louder. Velocity needs MIDI. On-screen keys can't measure it.
music_strings_th_dynamics_right: Dynamics: play the right hand louder. Velocity needs MIDI. On-screen keys can't measure it.
music_strings_th_keys_lr: Keys show L and R. Fingering is written only for Mirror hands.
music_strings_th_lane_label: Beat lane: {rows}. Notes in one column strike together.
music_strings_th_next_label: Closest chords, I IV V I
music_strings_th_next_reason: the next harmony step on the piano path
music_strings_th_none_landed: No notes landed on the beats. Start on the first click after the count-in.
music_strings_th_not_together: Every note right, but the hands struck together on only {n} of {total} beats.
music_strings_th_notes_hidden: Notes hidden. Keep the rhythm. Keys light only where you play.
music_strings_th_piano_label: Piano keyboard, {low} to {high}. Left hand keys marked L, right hand R.
music_strings_th_run_lane: Your run on the beat lane: {hands}, each note marked on time, early, late or missed.
music_strings_th_setup_help: Tempo comes from the top bar. Mirror hands starts at 60 to 66 BPM. Dynamics asks the melody hand to play louder. Velocity needs MIDI.
music_strings_th_spacing: The notes are right but the spacing wandered. Keep both hands on the click.
music_strings_th_together_midi: Hands landed together needs MIDI: both hands within 40 ms. On-screen keys play one note at a time, so an on-screen run shows it as not measured.
music_strings_th_weak_left: The left hand found {n} of {total} notes. Slow down and let that hand lead.
music_strings_th_weak_right: The right hand found {n} of {total} notes. Slow down and let that hand lead.

match.nPlural=other: Every part landed, but {n} wrong keys slipped in. Once more without them.

music_strings_tuning_err_note: "{part}" isn't a note with an octave, like E2 or Bb3.

music_strings_voicing_us_hint: The favourite upper structure: a major triad a whole step above the root.
